difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks locally of finite type over a locally Noetherian target has locally Noetherian source (author lemma at source lines 3524-3529, label lemma-locally-finite-type-locally-noetherian). The proof (source lines 3531-3547) chooses a presentation square, reads that the induced morphism of schemes is locally of finite type and that the presenting scheme of the target is locally Noetherian, and concludes by the corresponding statement for schemes (proof lines 3532-3546). The reduction through the presentation is the content. H2.
